blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Five members of an armed robbery group were shot dead following an encounter with the police in Bacoor, Cavite on Tuesday afternoon, Nov. 3. Bacoor Police Station chief PLt.Col. Alexie Desamito said the incident transpired at around 1 p.m. READ: Drug suspect wounded, arrested in alleged shootout with Cavite cops The group was said to be involved in a robbery-holdup in the Town and Country subdivision. The suspects allegedly opened fire after noticing police operatives, which prompted the pursuit. Two suspects managed to escape before being intercepted by authorities.
